findings.issue: `rw` chain of eight named lemmas with `ChannelLabel.ext_iff` listed twice, relying on the first rewrite consuming one disjunct so the second hits the other; same pattern at line 154 (`rw [← parity_eq_one_iff, ← parity_eq_one_iff]`). Such occurrence-order-dependent chains break on unrelated upstream or local changes to the statement shape.

summary: Proofs are short and omega-driven with no defeq abuse, but one reusable fact (equal parity plus equal Pauli status forces equal spin) is proved inline at three sites instead of being a lemma, and two proofs use occurrence-order-dependent rw chains where simp only would do.
